content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

A crypto payment gateway is an essential tool that enables digital creators to sell their products directly to consumers without relying on traditional payment processors. Unlike platforms like Gumroad, which charge up to 10% per transaction, solutions like NOWPayments only charge 0.5%. This significant difference means that for a creator making 100 sales a month at $97 each, they retain an extra $921, which can be reinvested into their business or used to expand their product offerings.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The backbone of a sovereign digital commerce stack begins with hosting on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. These services offer reliable and free hosting solutions. For backend logic, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle the processing of orders and payment verification. The integration with NOWPayments ensures that all transactions are processed in real-time using a variety of cryptocurrencies, enhancing security and reducing costs associated with traditional payment methods.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are either unavailable or too expensive. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, or other digital products, this stack provides the tools needed to operate independently. By removing dependencies on traditional payment gateways, creators regain control over their revenue and data, enabling them to build sustainable businesses without the constant worry of payment rejections or high fees.
Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments only charges 0.5%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign digital commerce stack consists of several key components: a hosting service (like GitHub Pages), backend logic (Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script), a database solution (Supabase or Google Sheets), a file delivery mechanism (Google Drive or Cloudflare R2), and a payment processor (NOWPayments). Each part plays a crucial role in ensuring that creators can deliver products seamlessly while maintaining ownership and control over their sales.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own sovereign digital commerce stack, start by selecting a hosting provider such as GitHub Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage order processing. Store your order data in Supabase or Google Sheets, and ensure that your digital products are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for automated crypto payment processing. For a comprehensive approach, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all the necessary blueprints and templates.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, leverage a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments. This solution allows you to accept payments in various cryptocurrencies at a minimal fee of 0.5%. By using a sovereign digital commerce stack, you maintain complete control over your sales and avoid the high fees of traditional platforms.
With 100 sales per month at $97, you retain an extra $921 using NOWPayments.

For those exploring options to sell digital downloads without platform fees, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers a comprehensive solution. It includes all six blueprints and seven templates necessary to establish your own sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose a hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for reliable hosting. 2. Set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle order processing. 3. Store order data in Supabase or Google Sheets for easy access and management. 4. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to deliver your digital products to customers. 5. Integrate NOWPayments for seamless crypto payment processing with minimal fees.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell your ebook using a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments, which allows you to accept various cryptocurrencies with just a 0.5% fee. This method provides a direct way to receive payments without relying on traditional platforms.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way is to set up a sovereign digital commerce stack using free tools for hosting, order management, and file delivery, while utilizing NOWPayments for payment processing. This approach significantly reduces your transaction fees.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, by deploying your own digital commerce stack, you can sell templates and fonts directly to consumers without relying on Gumroad or Payhip. This allows you to retain full control over your sales process.
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments offers a low transaction fee of 0.5%, supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, and requires no KYC or buyer accounts. This flexibility makes it an ideal solution for creators in regions with limited payment options.
How can I ensure automated delivery of my digital products?

You can automate delivery by using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file storage, combined with backend logic in Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This setup ensures that customers receive their purchases instantly upon payment confirmation.
Infrastructure sovereignty means you own your business without relying on traditional platforms.
